photos.c: THE COUNTY CHAMPIONSHIPS. Tony Brooks (41) 46th, John Kelly (45) 31st and Richard Moody (46) 36th seen competing in the Youth's Race. Adrian Major (18) and John Martin (20) were 16th and 45th respectively in the Junior event.
TOP RIGHT: Although not qualifying for the final of the 440y Tony Brooks later led the field home on the 1st leg of the 4 x 440y.
BOTTOM LEFT: Bill Kerr ponders his heaving chest while Tony Brooks sorts out a relay quartet with coach Dave Ansell (hidden).
TOP RIGHT: Tony Brooks finishs 3rd in the 440 (B).

Left: Nearly two miles gone in the '5¾'. It's September 1966 and among the 39 competitors in the race, this bunch are out to settle personal scores - or perhaps just enjoy the sunshine. The runners are: Financial wizards Keith Miller (106) and Jim Heathfield (93), Ted Pallant (94), talented youth and junior Tony Brooks (37) - lost to the sport before making impact as a senior, Dave McMillan (12) - now fighting back from terrible injuries sustained while out training and hit by a car, P.Blair-Fish (46).

Left: Part of the Belgrave T&F Team of '67 pose with President Frank Jarvis at the end of a successful season.
Back row: Brian King (throws), Chris Keavey (middle distance), Bill Couzens (throws), Don McLean (middle-distance and steeplechase), Frank Jarvis, Nick Head (javelin), Bob Taylor (Team Manager), Bill Dance (middle distance), Adrian Major (middle distance), Alan Black (middle-distance and steeplechase).
Front: John Mitchell (long jump and sprints), Phil Smith sprints John Martin (throws), Tony Brooks (440/880), Alan Mead 440/880).
